difficulty: medium: form with boxed fields, empty values, drawn check boxes (no text markers), Times standard-14, declaration text, signature lines
title: Community Garden Plot Application
key_sentences: Please complete all sections in block capitals and return the form to the association office.
Plots are allocated in order of the date the form is received.
I agree to keep my plot cultivated and free of weeds.
I will not use chemical pesticides on the site.
I understand that a plot left unused for three months may be reallocated.

list_items.text: I would like a plot near a water tap
I need a raised bed for reduced mobility
I am willing to share a plot

notes: Producer ReportLab 5.0.1 low-level canvas. Times-Roman, Times-Bold, Times-Italic and Courier (the filled-in applicant values), all standard-14, NOT embedded. The applicant block is a key/value form drawn as a boxed grid with a shaded label column: it is recorded as a table WITHOUT a header row, rows [label, value], and the empty fields (Telephone, Date of birth) have empty values. The check-box options are lists whose boxes are DRAWN rectangles (and an X drawn as two lines for ticked ones), so the list items carry no typed marker; the two 'Tick ...' lines are lead-ins, not items. The office-use box captions and the signature captions are furniture/form labels; the three declaration lines are separate short sentences.
